exclusionReason: Age=100 respondent excluded; could not be verified. Raw response preserved in source workbook.
flaggingReason: Six respondents had inconsistent switching reasons; set to missing, Yes/No answer retained.

derivedVariables.name: Estimated Weekly Gaming Hours
derivedVariables.formula: Weekday hours x 5 + Weekend hours x 2
derivedVariables.note: Assumes reported values represent a typical day.

derivedVariables.name: Switch Intent (Model Target)
derivedVariables.formula: Future platform != 'No plans to switch' -> 1; else -> 0

statisticalMethods: Pearson chi-square with Monte Carlo p-values for sparse tables
Spearman rank correlation for ordinal associations
Mann-Whitney U test for two-group ordinal comparisons
Holm step-down correction across 13 simultaneous tests
Cramer's V and rank-biserial correlation as effect sizes
Winsorization at 95th percentile for sensitivity analysis only
mlMethods: Logistic Regression with balanced class weights
Random Forest with balanced class weights
clusteringMethods: Silhouette score and inertia for k selection (k=2..6)
Cluster profiles computed as per-cluster means
limitations: N=205 is a small convenience sample; not generalisable.
Self-reported survey data; subject to recall bias.
Cloud Gaming (n=5) and AI-driven (n=4) categories too small for reliable inference.
Weekly hours are derived, not directly measured.
ML test set (~41 respondents) has high metric variance.
Genre Rise data are mentions per respondent (up to 2), not unique respondents.
privacyStatement: No individual respondent records are exposed. Only aggregate statistics, crosstabs, cluster profiles, and model metrics are published. Source workbooks excluded from repository.
